waypoints.name: Longbourn
waypoints.notes: Fictional Bennet estate, placed near a Hertfordshire Meryton cluster.

waypoints.name: Hunsford

waypoints.name: Pemberley

paths.title: Longbourn and Netherfield visits
paths.notes: Short fictional neighborhood travel for early Bennet and Bingley visits.

paths.title: Meryton and militia circuit
paths.notes: The route keeps militia, shops, and assemblies close to the Meryton cluster.

paths.title: Elizabeth goes to Hunsford
paths.notes: Longbourn and Hunsford are fictional, so the geodesic distance uses estimated anchors. Distance uses proxy coordinates for one or more fictional or estimated route anchors.

paths.title: Hunsford to Rosings
paths.notes: A nearby estate call rather than a long route.

paths.title: Lydia goes to Brighton
paths.notes: Lydia is allowed to go to Brighton with the Forsters; this is a source-supported family route, not the later London search. Distance uses proxy coordinates for one or more fictional or estimated route anchors.

paths.title: Derbyshire tour to Pemberley
paths.notes: The Gardiners and Elizabeth travel north to Derbyshire. Distance uses proxy coordinates for one or more fictional or estimated route anchors.

paths.title: Pemberley to Lambton
paths.notes: Short local move between the Derbyshire estate and the inn village.

paths.title: Return to Longbourn
paths.notes: The final chapter unit returns the map to Hertfordshire for the resolution. Distance uses proxy coordinates for one or more fictional or estimated route anchors.

paths.notes: Mr. Bennet and Mr. Gardiner search from Longbourn/London after Lydia and Wickham elope. Distance uses proxy coordinates for one or more fictional or estimated route anchors.
